newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sporitelna AGM approves dividend.
newsitem.headline: Czech Sporitelna AGM approves dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Czech savings bank Ceska Sporitelna a.s. voted on Thursday to pay out a 10 crown gross dividend per share on 1996 earnings, after a five crown dividend last year, the Czech news agency CTK reported.
Sporitelna recorded a 1.89 billion crown net profit last year, after 263 million in 1995 when auditors forced the bank to set aside large funds to boost reserves against doubtfull assets.
Sporitelna shares, with a 100 crown nominal value, stood at 269 crowns before the end of the session on Thursday, up one crown from Wednesday.
